newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields fall at auction.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields fall at auction.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month, nine-month and 12-month Ukraine discount treasury bills edged down from previous sales, a central bank statement said on Monday.
Six-month bills edged down to 27.01 percent from 28.36 percent, nine-month bills were down to 28.99 percent from 30.85 percent and 12-month bills edged down to 32.98 percent from 34.32 percent.
Results of six-month T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 10.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Amount sold 10.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 8.81 million UAH 17.52 million UAH
The central bank sold 100,000 T-bills, the bank statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 13.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 6.90 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Amount sold 6.90 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.67 million UAH 8.13 million UAH
The central bank sold 69.000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 13.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 18.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Amount sold 18.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.54 million UAH 14.90 million UAH
The central bank sold 180,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 13.
